title: Skill distribution: stop copying, fetch at boot
description: Research dated 10 October 2026. Nothing has changed yet.

options.fresh: Yes, if the boot network works
options.runtimes: All; one hook per cloud runtime
options.upkeep: Low: one script in the catalog
Low: repo list, overlays, CI exclusions

options.manual: No: a bump PR per repo

options.option: 5. npx skills or gh skill per box
options.manual: No: an install step per box

props.content: The copy-and-PR workflow fails its own goal of no manual steps. Stop copying: keep one public catalog and fetch it at boot.

props.title: Copying skills is already broken
props.deck: Seven sync runs failed, consumers hold stale copies, and one change would still need twelve merges.

rows.title: Sync never ran
rows.body: All seven sync-skills.yml runs since 14 September failed because `SKILLS_SYNC_TOKEN` was never set.

rows.title: Copies are stale
rows.body: Each consumer holds 20 skills: one outdated, three missing, all from hand-merged first PRs.

rows.title: Three copies of everything
rows.body: Source repo, `agents2/content/skills`, and each consumer's `.agents/skills`, plus a pinned snapshot on disk.

rows.title: One PR per repo per change
rows.body: Twelve merges before a fresh clone is current.

rows.title: Mac update is a six-step chore
rows.body: Push, bump three files, re-vendor, update provenance, test, apply and doctor. `agents2 update` also mishandles git pins.

rows.title: Repo plumbing
rows.body: CI exclusions for `.agents/**`, overlay rules for four repos, a hand-kept `consumers.yml`, and a PAT with write access to 12 repos.

props.title: Five ways to fix it
props.deck: Only one option needs no manual step, no write token and works in every runtime.

props.caption: Five options against the goals, recommended first. Rows that look the same across options are hidden.

props.content: Options 4 and 5 can **complement** option 3 but not replace it. The MCP-server approach is a poor fit: runtimes find skills as files on disk, and skills can include scripts.

props.title: Stop copying, fetch at boot
props.deck: Repos hold a pointer, never a skill copy. Skills live in two places: the source repo, and user-level directories on each box.
props.takeaway: A skill changes once, in agent-skills, and every box picks it up.

left.label: On Macs
left.body: Keep user-level installs through agents2. Remove the vendored `content/skills/` copies. Link skills into `~/.cursor/skills`. Make a pin update one command: `agents2 bump agent-skills`.

right.label: On cloud boxes
right.body: Add `scripts/bootstrap.sh` to the public agent-skills repo. It fetches `main` (or `AGENT_SKILLS_REF`) and extracts into the user-level skill folders for agents, Cursor, Claude and Codex.

rows.right: Tracks main, with a ref override

props.title: One fixed line per runtime
props.deck: It never changes when skills change.

props.caption: The one fixed line each runtime carries. It never changes when skills change.

items.title: Claude Code cloud
items.body: A SessionStart hook, only when CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE is true.

items.title: Codex cloud
items.body: A setup line, set per environment, not per repo.

items.title: Pi
items.body: Runs on Macs, so already covered.

props.title: One small step first
props.deck: Prove the Cursor path on a single repo before rolling it out.

items.text: Write an idempotent ~20-line scripts/bootstrap.sh that honours AGENT_SKILLS_REF
Add one line to termscope's existing .cursor/install.sh
Start one Cursor Cloud agent and list its skills
Check whether Cursor Cloud reads ~/.cursor/skills or ~/.agents/skills at install time
Delete consumers.yml, sync-skills.yml, fan-out modes and the token docs

props.summary: What gets deleted, and what stays

props.content:
- **agent-skills:** `consumers.yml`, `sync-skills.yml`, the fan-out and prepare-pr modes, the unused vendor action and the token docs.
- **Consumers:** the catalog copies and the `.agents/**` exclusions made for them.
- **agents2:** the vendored catalog, the provenance test and the matching `PROVENANCE.md` section.
- **Stay:** product-specific skills in clockwork, plannotator and visual-artifact-renderer.

props.title: Five questions for Iury
props.deck: None of these block the first step.
props.takeaway: Answer these before the Mac side changes.

props.question: Should Macs keep the pin with a one-command bump, or track main?

options.label: Keep the pin
options.consequence: Keeps agents2's lock guarantee; needs a bump.

options.label: Track main
options.consequence: No bump, but no lock guarantee for this record.

props.question: Is one static bootstrap line per repo acceptable?

options.label: Yes, one line
options.consequence: The realistic minimum with current runtimes.

options.label: Zero agent files in repos
options.consequence: Not achievable with current runtime setup.

props.question: Enable Cursor's Sync Skills for Cloud Agents as a backup path?

options.label: Yes
options.consequence: A second route for Cursor Cloud.

props.content: Still open: whether Claude Code cloud or Codex cloud are in use at all, and whether repo-local product skills stay. The recommendation is to keep them; they are not catalog skills.
